tools.name: compare_basket
tools.description: Prices a shopping list at every store in the country: each store's total for the items it sells (with its delivery fee where the store publishes one), the cheapest single store, and the cheapest way to split the list between stores. Items are matched to products by their names, or exactly by product

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Lists the stores Basko covers in a country: their kind, whether their prices are compared now, where the prices come from, delivery fees and links to their sites. With latitude and longitude, also each store's nearest branches with the distance and opening hours (branches are known in Uzbekistan).

tools.name: find_swaps
tools.description: For the items of a shopping list, finds products that do the same job for less: a bigger pack that costs less per kilogram, litre or piece, or another brand of the same kind of product. Each swap says how much cheaper it is per unit and what it saves on the item's quantity.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Lists current deals in a country: products whose price is well below their usual price or clearly lower at one store than at the others, and the biggest price drops of the past week. tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one product's current price at every store in the country that sells it (cheapest first, with delivery and where each price comes from), its lowest price day by day over the last 3 months, and a deal score that compares today's price with its usual price. Product ids come from search_product

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches Basko's price database for products sold by stores in one country and returns, for each product, its listings ordered by price (cheapest in-stock first), the number of stores selling it, the size and price per kilogram, litre or piece when known, and links to the listings.
